definitions.explanation: A literary work expressing feelings and ideas in verse.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{詩|し}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。

examples.english: I've liked writing poetry ever since I was a child.

notes:
{詩|し} refers to poetry or poems—literary works expressing emotions and ideas through rhythmic language and imagery.

SCOPE:
{詩|し} typically refers to free verse or Western-style poetry. Traditional Japanese forms have their own terms.

TYPES OF POETRY:
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧: haiku (17 syllables)
- ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧: tanka (31 syllables)
- ⟦{川柳|せんりゅう}→川柳：09660_senryuu⟧: senryū (humorous haiku-like form)
- ⟦{漢詩|かんし}→漢詩：13438_kanshi⟧: Chinese-style poetry
- ⟦{現代詩|げんだいし}→現代詩：27877_gendaishi⟧: modern free verse

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {詩|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write poetry
- {詩|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read poetry
- {詩|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧: to compose/recite poetry (literary)
- ⟦{詩的|してき}→詩的：05630_shiteki⟧な: poetic

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧: poet
- ⟦{詩集|ししゅう}→詩集：05411_shishuu⟧: poetry collection
- ⟦{詩歌|しいか}→詩歌：27819_shiika⟧: poetry (broader term, includes songs)
- ⟦{韻|いん}→韻：14920_in⟧: rhyme
